$comment: Microsoft Store package identity, copied from Partner Center → the product → Product management → Product identity. Not secrets. displayName is the Store-facing name reserved in Partner Center (must equal STORE_APP_NAME in src/shared/appIdentity.ts); identityName and publisher are the immutable package identity. Environment variables (STORE_IDENTITY_NAME, STORE_PUBLISHER, STORE_PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME, STORE_DISPLAY_NAME, STORE_PRODUCT_ID or STORE_ID) override this file. See docs/MICROSOFT_STORE.md.
